title: RosterCourseResponse
description:
The response that contains a list of courses.

Introduced in Device Assignment Services 5.0.

courses.description: Provides information about courses, sorted in lexical order by a course `source_system_identifier`. The organization must provide this identifier to Apple.

cursor.description: A hex string that should be used for the next request to paginate. This field data type has a maximum length of 512 UTF-8 characters.

more_to_follow.description: Indicates whether the request’s limit and cursor values resulted in only a partial list of classes. If true, the MDM server should then make another request (starting from the newly returned cursor) to obtain additional records.
